document.title: Local or imported food
document.question:
Some people believe that countries should produce most of their own food rather than relying on imports. Others argue that importing food from other countries is cheaper and gives consumers more choice.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
